title: Epiphone Embassy Bass, Smoked Almond Metallic

long_description.title: Epiphone's Premier Solidbody Bass
long_description.body: Ever since it was first introduced in 1963 the Epiphone Embassy Bass has been a player favorite, and now it's back and better than ever. Featuring an asymmetrical solid mahogany double-cutaway body, a 34" scale mahogany neck capped with an Indian laurel fretboard with 20 medium jumbo frets, a 2 x 2 headstock design for improved balance, and a pair of powerful ProBucker™ 760 humbucking pickups, along with master volume and tone controls, as well as a pickup blend knob for outstanding tonal versatility.

Hardware Specs.Control Knobs: Epiphone Historic Barrel knobs with metal inserts
Hardware Specs.Pickguard: Black - White on Graphite Black model
Hardware Specs.Strap Buttons: 2 - bottom and tip of upper horn

Misc Specs.Headstock Inlay: Epiphone logo in Mother of Pearl
